## 1. NEW TEMPLATE: `templates/99-wifi-repeater.netplan.j2`

```jinja2
# Netplan configuration for WiFi repeater persistent IP
# Generated by Ansible - auto-applied via netplan apply

---
network:
  version: 2
  renderer: networkd

  wifis:
    {{ wifi_interface_repeater }}:
      optional: true
      dhcp4: false
      dhcp6: false
      addresses:
        - {{ repeater_ip }}/24
      # No default routes; clients access upstream via hostapd NAT
      # No nameservers; clients get them via dnsmasq DHCP
```

## 2. NEW TEMPLATE: `templates/iptables-save.j2`

```jinja2
# iptables save file for WiFi repeater NAT + forwarding
# Applied via iptables-persistent
# Manually reload: sudo iptables-restore < /etc/iptables/rules.v4

*filter
:INPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:FORWARD ACCEPT [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]

# Accept all established/related
-A FORWARD -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT

# Repeater → Uplink: allow clients to reach outside
-A FORWARD -i {{ wifi_interface_repeater }} -o {{ wifi_interface_uplink }} -j ACCEPT

# Uplink → Repeater: return traffic
-A FORWARD -i {{ wifi_interface_uplink }} -o {{ wifi_interface_repeater }} -m conntrack --ctstate RELATED,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT

COMMIT

*nat
:PREROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]
:INPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:POSTROUTING ACCEPT [0:0]

# Masquerade clients behind Pi's uplink IP
-A POSTROUTING -o {{ wifi_interface_uplink }} -j MASQUERADE

COMMIT
```

## 3. NEW TEMPLATE: `templates/wifi-repeater-watchdog.sh.j2`

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# WiFi Repeater Health Monitor
# Run every 5 minutes via cron to detect and fix common issues
# Logs to /var/log/wifi-repeater-watchdog.log

set -euo pipefail

HOSTAPD_INTERFACE="{{ wifi_interface_repeater }}"
DNSMASQ_CONF="/etc/dnsmasq.d/wifi-repeater.conf"
REPEATER_IP="{{ repeater_ip }}"
LOG_FILE="/var/log/wifi-repeater-watchdog.log"

# Exit if check_mode (dry-run)
if [ "${ANSIBLE_CHECK_MODE:-false}" = "true" ]; then
    exit 0
fi

log() {
    echo "[$(date +'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] $*" >> "$LOG_FILE"
}

# Initialize log if missing
touch "$LOG_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true

log "=== WiFi Repeater Health Check Started ==="

RESTART_HOSTAPD=0
RESTART_DNSMASQ=0

# --- Check 1: hostapd running ---
if ! systemctl is-active --quiet hostapd; then
    log "⚠️  hostapd not running. Restarting..."
    systemctl restart hostapd 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
    RESTART_HOSTAPD=1
    sleep 2
else
    log "✓ hostapd is running"
fi

# --- Check 2: dnsmasq running ---
if ! systemctl is-active --quiet dnsmasq; then
    log "⚠️  dnsmasq not running. Restarting..."
    systemctl restart dnsmasq 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
    RESTART_DNSMASQ=1
    sleep 2
else
    log "✓ dnsmasq is running"
fi

# --- Check 3: Repeater interface is UP ---
if ! ip link show "$HOSTAPD_INTERFACE" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "UP"; then
    log "⚠️  Interface $HOSTAPD_INTERFACE is DOWN. Bringing up..."
    ip link set "$HOSTAPD_INTERFACE" up 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
    sleep 1
else
    log "✓ Interface $HOSTAPD_INTERFACE is UP"
fi

# --- Check 4: Repeater interface has correct IP ---
if ! ip addr show "$HOSTAPD_INTERFACE" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$REPEATER_IP"; then
    log "⚠️  Interface $HOSTAPD_INTERFACE does not have IP $REPEATER_IP. Reconfiguring..."
    ip addr replace "$REPEATER_IP/24" dev "$HOSTAPD_INTERFACE" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
    sleep 1
else
    log "✓ Interface $HOSTAPD_INTERFACE has correct IP"
fi

# --- Check 5: hostapd_cli responds ---
if ! timeout 2 hostapd_cli -i "$HOSTAPD_INTERFACE" status > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    log "⚠️  hostapd_cli timeout or error. Restarting hostapd..."
    systemctl restart hostapd 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
    RESTART_HOSTAPD=1
    sleep 2
else
    log "✓ hostapd responding to management commands"
fi

# --- Check 6: dnsmasq listening ---
if ! ss -tlnup 2>/dev/null | grep -q "dnsmasq.*$REPEATER_IP.*:53"; then
    log "⚠️  dnsmasq not listening on $REPEATER_IP:53. Restarting..."
    systemctl restart dnsmasq 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
    RESTART_DNSMASQ=1
    sleep 2
else
    log "✓ dnsmasq listening on $REPEATER_IP:53"
fi

# --- Check 7: iptables NAT rules present ---
if ! iptables -t nat -L POSTROUTING -n 2>/dev/null | grep -q MASQUERADE; then
    log "⚠️  iptables NAT rules missing. Restoring..."
    iptables-restore < /etc/iptables/rules.v4 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG_FILE"
else
    log "✓ iptables NAT rules present"
fi

# --- Check 8: Count clients ---
CLIENT_COUNT=$(hostapd_cli -i "$HOSTAPD_INTERFACE" list_sta 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
log "ℹ️  $CLIENT_COUNT clients connected to $HOSTAPD_INTERFACE"

# --- Summary ---
if [ "$RESTART_HOSTAPD" -eq 1 ] || [ "$RESTART_DNSMASQ" -eq 1 ]; then
    log "⚠️  ALERT: Services were restarted. Check connectivity."
else
    log "✓ All systems nominal"
fi

log "=== Health Check Complete ==="
exit 0
```

## 4. NEW TASK FILE: `tasks/00-validate.yml`

```yaml
---
# Pre-flight validation for WiFi repeater role

- name: Validate repeater interface configuration
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - wifi_interface_uplink != wifi_interface_repeater
      - wifi_interface_uplink | length > 0
      - wifi_interface_repeater | length > 0
      - repeater_ip | length > 0
      - wifi_repeater_ssid | length > 0
    fail_msg: |
      Configuration validation failed:
      - uplink ({{ wifi_interface_uplink }}) must differ from repeater ({{ wifi_interface_repeater }})
      - All variables must be non-empty
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, validate]
  changed_when: false

- name: Check if nl80211 driver is loaded
  ansible.builtin.command: "modinfo nl80211"
  register: nl80211_check
  failed_when: false
  changed_when: false
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, validate]

- name: Warn if nl80211 not available
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: |
      ⚠️  WARNING: nl80211 kernel module not found.
      WiFi AP mode may not work on this system.
      Try: sudo modprobe nl80211
  when: nl80211_check.rc != 0
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, validate]

- name: Check WiFi adapter capabilities
  ansible.builtin.command: "iw list"
  register: iw_capabilities
  failed_when: false
  changed_when: false
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, validate]

- name: Verify AP mode is supported
  ansible.builtin.assert:
    that:
      - "'AP' in iw_capabilities.stdout or '__ap' in iw_capabilities.stdout"
    fail_msg: |
      Your WiFi adapter does not support AP (access point) mode.
      This role requires a WiFi card capable of being an AP.
      Check compatibility: iw list | grep -A 10 'Supported interface modes'
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, validate]

- name: Check for required packages
  ansible.builtin.command: "which {{ item }}"
  register: pkg_check
  failed_when: false
  changed_when: false
  loop:
    - hostapd
    - dnsmasq
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, validate]

- name: Validation summary
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: |
      ✓ Pre-flight checks passed:
      - Interfaces: {{ wifi_interface_uplink }} (uplink) → {{ wifi_interface_repeater }} (repeater)
      - Repeater SSID: {{ wifi_repeater_ssid }}
      - IP: {{ repeater_ip }}/24
      - DHCP Range: {{ repeater_dhcp_start }} - {{ repeater_dhcp_end }}
      - WiFi standard: {{ wifi_hw_mode | default('g') }} @ Channel {{ wifi_channel }}
  tags: [debug, wifi, wifi-repeater]
```

## 5. NEW TASK FILE: `tasks/05-network-config.yml`

```yaml
---
# Persistent network configuration for WiFi repeater

- name: Create netplan configuration for repeater IP
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: 99-wifi-repeater.netplan.j2
    dest: /etc/netplan/99-wifi-repeater.yaml
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0600"
  register: netplan_result
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, network]

- name: Apply netplan changes
  ansible.builtin.command: "netplan apply"
  changed_when: netplan_result.changed
  when: not ansible_check_mode
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, network]

- name: Wait for interface to be ready
  ansible.builtin.pause:
    seconds: 2
  when: netplan_result.changed and not ansible_check_mode
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, network]

- name: Verify repeater IP is configured
  ansible.builtin.command: "ip addr show {{ wifi_interface_repeater }}"
  register: ip_check
  failed_when: repeater_ip not in ip_check.stdout
  changed_when: false
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, network]

- name: Enable IPv4 forwarding
  ansible.posix.sysctl:
    name: net.ipv4.ip_forward
    value: "1"
    sysctl_set: true
    state: present
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, network]

- name: Optional: Enable IPv6 forwarding
  ansible.posix.sysctl:
    name: net.ipv6.conf.all.forwarding
    value: "{% if wifi_enable_ipv6 | default(false) %}1{% else %}0{% endif %}"
    sysctl_set: true
    state: present
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, network]
```

## 6. NEW TASK FILE: `tasks/06-firewall.yml`

```yaml
---
# Persistent iptables configuration for WiFi repeater

- name: Install iptables-persistent for rule persistence
  ansible.builtin.apt:
    name: iptables-persistent
    state: present
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, packages, firewall]

- name: Create iptables rules directory
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: /etc/iptables
    state: directory
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0755"
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, firewall]

- name: Deploy persistent iptables rules
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: iptables-save.j2
    dest: /etc/iptables/rules.v4
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0600"
  register: iptables_result
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, firewall]

- name: Restore iptables rules from file
  ansible.builtin.command: "iptables-restore < /etc/iptables/rules.v4"
  changed_when: iptables_result.changed
  when: not ansible_check_mode
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, firewall]

- name: Enable netfilter-persistent service
  ansible.builtin.systemd:
    name: netfilter-persistent
    enabled: true
    state: started
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, service, firewall]

- name: Verify iptables rules are loaded
  ansible.builtin.command: "iptables -t nat -L POSTROUTING -n"
  register: iptables_check
  failed_when: "'MASQUERADE' not in iptables_check.stdout"
  changed_when: false
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, firewall]
```

```yaml
# WiFi Repeater role - Configure hostapd and dnsmasq for WiFi repeating

  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, config]

- name: Include dnsmasq configuration tasks
  ansible.builtin.include_tasks: 04-dnsmasq-config.yml
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, config]

- name: Include network configuration tasks
  ansible.builtin.include_tasks: 05-network-config.yml
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, network]

- name: Include firewall configuration tasks
  ansible.builtin.include_tasks: 06-firewall.yml
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, firewall]

- name: Include service management tasks
  ansible.builtin.include_tasks: 07-services.yml
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, service]

- name: Include monitoring setup tasks
  ansible.builtin.include_tasks: 08-monitoring.yml
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, monitoring]

- name: Display final configuration summary
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: |
      ✓ WiFi Repeater Deployment Complete!

      Configuration:
      - SSID: {{ wifi_repeater_ssid }}
      - Channel: {{ wifi_channel }}
      - Country: {{ wifi_country }}
      - Repeater IP: {{ repeater_ip }}
      - DHCP Range: {{ repeater_dhcp_start }} - {{ repeater_dhcp_end }}
      - Uplink: {{ wifi_interface_uplink }} → Repeater: {{ wifi_interface_repeater }}

      Verify with:
        sudo systemctl status hostapd dnsmasq
        sudo hostapd_cli -i {{ wifi_interface_repeater }} status
        sudo hostapd_cli -i {{ wifi_interface_repeater }} list_sta
        tail -f /var/log/wifi-repeater-watchdog.log

      Troubleshoot with:
        journalctl -u hostapd -u dnsmasq -f
        sudo iw dev {{ wifi_interface_repeater }} station dump
        sudo wavemon
  tags: [debug, wifi, wifi-repeater]
```

## 8. NEW TASK FILE: `tasks/08-monitoring.yml`

```yaml
---
# Monitoring and self-healing setup for WiFi repeater

- name: Deploy WiFi repeater watchdog script
  ansible.builtin.template:
    src: wifi-repeater-watchdog.sh.j2
    dest: /usr/local/bin/wifi-repeater-watchdog.sh
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0755"
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, monitoring]

- name: Create watchdog log file
  ansible.builtin.file:
    path: /var/log/wifi-repeater-watchdog.log
    state: touch
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0644"
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, monitoring]

- name: Install health check cron job (every 5 minutes)
  ansible.builtin.cron:
    name: "WiFi Repeater Health Check"
    minute: "*/5"
    job: "/usr/local/bin/wifi-repeater-watchdog.sh > /dev/null 2>&1"
    user: root
    state: present
    disabled: false
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, monitoring]

- name: Optional: Install systemd timer (alternative to cron)
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    dest: /etc/systemd/system/wifi-repeater-watchdog.timer
    content: |
      [Unit]
      Description=WiFi Repeater Health Check Timer
      Requires=wifi-repeater-watchdog.service

      [Timer]
      OnBootSec=1min
      OnUnitActiveSec=5min
      Persistent=true

      [Install]
      WantedBy=timers.target
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0644"
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, monitoring, optional]

- name: Install systemd watchdog service unit
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    dest: /etc/systemd/system/wifi-repeater-watchdog.service
    content: |
      [Unit]
      Description=WiFi Repeater Health Check
      After=network.target

      [Service]
      Type=oneshot
      ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/wifi-repeater-watchdog.sh

      [Install]
      WantedBy=multi-user.target
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0644"
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, monitoring, optional]

- name: Log rotation for watchdog
  ansible.builtin.copy:
    dest: /etc/logrotate.d/wifi-repeater-watchdog
    content: |
      /var/log/wifi-repeater-watchdog.log {
          daily
          rotate 7
          compress
          delaycompress
          missingok
          notifempty
          create 0644 root root
      }
    owner: root
    group: root
    mode: "0644"
  tags: [wifi, wifi-repeater, monitoring]
```
